newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Grocer Philippine Seven lowers IPO price range.
newsitem.headline: Grocer Philippine Seven lowers IPO price range.

text.p: Philippine Seven Corp, the exclusive franchise holder of 7-Eleven convenience stores in the country, has lowered its initial public offering price range to 6.30- 7.71 pesos per share from the previous range of 8.24-9.72.
Philippine Seven did not give any reason for the price change which was disclosed in a revised prospectus submitted to the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) on Tuesday.

The company is still awaiting the final approval of the SEC and the stock exchange before starting the offering period of its shares to local nationals and corporations. Under Philippine law, foreigners are not allowed to own shares in retail firms.
BPI Capital Corp has been tapped to be the lead underwriter for the IPO.
Last year, Philippine Seven posted a net income of 75.106 million pesos. It is projecting a net of 108.45 million this year and 177.66 million by the end of next year.
